card.name: Words introducing repeated intervals
card.fires_on: Small words like at, after, repeated or back that lead into a recurring schedule, such as 'at weekly intervals' or 'repeated every 21 days'. Mostly in dose-adjustment instructions.

modes.label: Dose steps at intervals
modes.description: The word 'at' after an increment amount, before 'weekly' or 'bi-weekly intervals'.
modes.example: daily dose may be raised in increments of 5 mg<< at>> weekly intervals until optimal response obtained.

modes.label: Repeat cycles
modes.description: The word 'repeated' before a schedule such as 'every 21 days' or 'as often as required'.

modes.description: The word 'back' in a request to come again each week.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning 'each time' or 'repeatedly' and away from words meaning 'new' or 'fresh'.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a text is about to say something happens again and again on a schedule.
